items.title: Ultimate Coffee Duo
items.description: Not sure which espresso blend you would like most? We’ve made it easier for you to decide by bundling our top-selling blends at a cheeky discounted price. Veloce (250g) is our flagship blend, the one you’ll find in most cafes serving Atomic. It’s crafted to make a smooth, complex espresso with notes of dark chocolate, cinnamon and stone fruit. and a balanced flat white. Supremo (250g) is for the ‘strong’ coffee lovers – full-bodied, rich in deep chocolate undertones, and elevated by a confectionary sweetness that becomes caramel-like with milk. Our notes for this blend are cacao nibs, marshmallow and clove . Bundle these two classics together and save $6.00!

items.title: Veloce
items.description: Veloce is our flagship blend - a rich, sweet and complex espresso that pours like velvet. Roasted delicately so notes of bittersweet chocolate, cinnamon spice and ripe stone fruit cut through. Delicious with or without milk, it's true espresso - the aficionados’ choice.

items.title: Supremo
items.description: Called Supremo for a reason, it is a blend with remarkable full-bodied sweetness, great depth of flavour and complexity, and lingering clove and cinnamon spice notes. As an espresso, Supremo has strong dark cocoa flavours, a creamy, smooth body and a soft sweet finish.

items.title: Decaf
items.origin_country: Honduras, Marcala Cooperative: COMSA Variety: Lempira, Catuai, Catimor
items.process: Fully washed, mountain water decaffeination Altitude : 1,200-1,800 masl Roast Depth : Medium Characteristics Body: silky Acidity: medium Finish: clean
items.description: When it comes to flavour there is nothing weak or washed out about our organic decaf. Mountain water decaffeination removes the caffeine naturally and ensures that the body is retained. The result is malt buttery sweetness, a silky smooth body and delightfully clean finish. A decaf that actually tastes like coffee. Origin: Honduras, Marcala Cooperative: COMSA Variety: Lempira, Catuai, Catimor Processing: Fully washed, mountain water decaffeination Altitude : 1,200-1,800 masl Roast Depth : Medium Characteristics Body: silky Acidity: medium Finish: clean Flavour notes: Malt, molasses Recommended use Espresso, stovetop, plunger, Aeropress, filter

items.title: Brazil Sitio Da Torre | Espresso Roast
items.description: Brazil, reimagined.This one starts out as you might expect for a Brazil, with a solid foundation of creamy nuts, honey and cocoa, it then transitions into bright florals and citric acidity bringing freshness. Silky with clear notes of toffee and a light, refreshing finish, this is a Brazil that trades heaviness for elegance and vibrancy. Variety: Yellow Bourbon Processing: Natural Flavour notes: Pomelo, Floral Honey, Pistachio With milk: Almond , Black Tea Recommended use: Espresso
items.flavour_notes: Pomelo, Floral Honey, Pistachio With milk: Almond , Black Tea Recommended use: Espresso

items.title: Rwanda Vincent Rukeribuga | Filter Roast
items.description: Bursting with vibrant fruits and remarkable complexity, this coffee is lavishly sweet, full-bodied and deeply expressive. The controlled anaerobic fermentation creates a rich and decadent experience of ripe blueberries, strawberry compote & sweet apples. With a lot going on this coffee delivers a beautifully balanced, long, and elegant finish with sweetness that seems to last forever. Variety: Bourbon Processing: Anaerobic Natural Flavour notes: Ambrosia Apple, Black Forest, Ripe Blueberry Recommended use: Filter
items.flavour_notes: Ambrosia Apple, Black Forest, Ripe Blueberry Recommended use: Filter

items.title: Kenya Gachika | Filter Roast
items.description: A mysterious and magnetic washed Kenyan. This is a coffee of depth and intrigue, where rich prune sweetness leads into flashes of zesty lime. Lingering beneath its shadowy exterior, lays a rich Cabernet Sauvignon, full of ripe plums and subtle tannins. The complexity of this Kenya continues to unfold with every sip. Variety: SL 28, Ruiru 11, Batian Processing: Washed Flavour notes: Prune, Cabernet Sauvignon, Lime Recommended use: Filter 200g
items.flavour_notes: Prune, Cabernet Sauvignon, Lime Recommended use: Filter 200g

items.title: Indonesia Yolan Tirta | Filter Roast
items.description: A comforting, clear and quietly complex Typica from Indonesia. Crisp pear notes provide freshness and lift, while toasted nuts and hot chocolate create a familiar sweetness. Smooth-bodied and nicely balanced, this coffee finishes clean and anchored, inviting another sip before the cup is empty. Variety: Typica Processing: Washed Tasting notes: Red Pear, Hazelnut, Hot Chocolate Recomending use: Filter
items.flavour_notes: Red Pear, Hazelnut, Hot Chocolate Recomending use: Filter
